evidence.vulnerability: FileStore.file() in 9.0.35 uses String.startsWith() to validate session file paths stay within the configured store directory. A sibling directory whose name is a string-prefix of the store directory (e.g., sessions-extra vs sessions) bypasses this check. Fixed in 9.0.43 by switching to java.nio.file.Path.startsWith() which compares path components.
evidence.original_vector: JSESSIONID=../../../../tmp/payload -- path traversal to /tmp/payload.session (blocked by 9.0.35 canonical path check)
evidence.residual_vector: JSESSIONID=../sessions-extra/payload -- sibling directory bypass; canonical path /usr/local/tomcat/sessions-extra/payload.session string-starts-with /usr/local/tomcat/sessions (passes 9.0.35 check, blocked by 9.0.43 Path check)
